row:
Hi Welcome to our channel Pony Fun with Clover & Jasmine. We have set this channel up to document the journey of 5 year old Jasmine and 8 year old Clover learning to ride. 
Our channel features:
8.2hh Miniature Shetland Pony Blossom who is 18 years old
11hh Rescue Pony Daisy - We will provide updates on her progress along the way
Nannies 14hh Skewbald Cob Spicy
15hh Appaloosa x Cob Angel (3 years)
12.3hh Welsh Section C Mai (4 Years)

We post weekly videos of our adventures and lots of short videos in-between and we love to share what we are getting up to so please subscribe and click the notification bell so you don't miss any pony fun.
